text:
maria: FYI, ACME reported an unexpected KMS decrypt (key=redwood-prod-logs) at 2024-11-25T17:11:58Z. They say they didn't trigger it. Can we reconstruct timeline from audit logs?

security-bot: Incident created: INC-2024-345 (https://redwood.incidents/INC-2024-345)

jason: I'm on it. Which audit index has KMS events now? audit.events_v2?

sre-alex: audit.events_v2 is the right one post-schema v2. Query I'm running:
```
index=audit.events_v2 action=kms.decrypt key_id="redwood-prod-logs" | sort ts asc | limit 50
```

jason: got a decrypt log, snippet:
```
{"ts":"2024-11-25T17:11:58Z","actor":"svc-data-ingest@redwood.com","actor_type":"service_account","action":"kms.decrypt","key_id":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/redwood-prod-logs","result":"SUCCESS","request_id":"req-9f8a","ip":"10.140.32.5","user_agent":"python-requests/2.31"}
```

kevin: svc-data-ingest is a service account we run. Did we just give it KMS permissions recently? I recall an RBAC change this afternoon.

maria: Need iam audit events around 16:45-17:00 UTC. Look for iam.setPolicy or policy.bindings changes for that key.

sre-alex: found iam.setPolicy at 2024-11-25T16:49:30Z. Snippet:
```
{"ts":"2024-11-25T16:49:30Z","actor":"deploy-bot@redwood.com","action":"iam.setPolicy","target":"projects/prod/locations/global/keyRings/main/cryptoKeys/redwood-prod-logs","changes":"[{\"op\":\"add\",\"role\":\"roles/kms.cryptoOperator\",\"member\":\"serviceAccount:svc-data-ingest@redwood.com\"}]","request_id":"req-9f6b"}
```

kevin: that's 22 minutes before decrypt. explains access. Was that change customer-requested or internal?

maria: Cross-checked support ticket SUP-1289 — account exec requested onboarding script that included key access. Support confirms it.

jason: note — schema v2 added "actor_type" and "request_id" fields last month. Those were critical here to map service accounts vs human users. We've got a follow-up to add request_id to customer-facing audit exports (ENG-PLAT-145).

deploy-bot: Export job created for INC-2024-345: /exports/INC-2024-345/audit_evidence.zip

maria: Action items: (1) prepare timeline & attach logs to incident, (2) notify ACME with proof of iam.setPolicy + decrypt event, (3) update external audit export to include request_id. Assigning to kevin for customer comms. :white_check_mark:

kevin: Will draft reply and include the two log snippets and the support ticket reference. Will also ask sales to confirm onboarding request.

maria: closing the loop here unless new info. If ACME asks for more, we'll reopen. Thanks all.
